libraries.name: Network layout
libraries.description: Physical network devices with socket-centred cable connections: consumer switches, routers and access points, plus matching 19-inch 1U switches, routers, firewalls and patch panels.

libraries.name: Embedded processors and smart home
libraries.description: Physical PCB views of ESP32/ESP8266 devkits, Raspberry Pi 3/4/5, Arduino Uno/Nano/Mega, 26 sensor/actuator modules and 8 LCD/OLED/touch/e-paper displays. Original vector artwork, function icons and labelled header-pad connections. Named revisions; wiring layouts without simulation models.

libraries.name: Audio & Music
libraries.description: 99 compact original vector resources for live sound, studios, podcasts, recording, churches and schools. Microphones, mixers, recording interfaces, instruments/MIDI, speakers, amplifiers, routing, connectors and stage equipment. Connections represent whole cables centred in their sockets.

libraries.name: Test & Measurement
libraries.description: 78 compact original vector laboratory setup resources: supplies, loads, oscilloscopes, meters, RF instruments, acquisition, probes, heaters, thermal equipment, relays, controls, pumps and bench apparatus. Separate conductor, complete-cable and fluid-hose connection points; no simulation models.

libraries.name: Solar power and batteries
libraries.description: 52 conceptual home-energy planning symbols: solar panels and arrays, inverters, batteries, EV chargers, supply and backup equipment, protection, monitoring and home loads. Connections represent whole cables or logical links, rather than physical electrical terminals.

libraries.name: SPICE essentials
libraries.description: Standard onetransistor symbols with SPICE models and sources. Includes generic teaching models and a 741-style behavioral model.

libraries.name: Digital logic
libraries.description: Gates, counters and storage with educational SPICE models. Wire supplies to VCC and VSS; connect VSS to ground when required.

libraries.name: Functional blocks
libraries.description: Functional interfaces with configurable educational SPICE behaviour, including ADC/DAC, communication, state machines and programmable I/O.

libraries.name: Sensors and interfaces
libraries.description: Sensors, a test point, analogue switch and AM modulator with configurable educational SPICE models and explicit electrical terminals.
